- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase

exhibits.argument: The buyer states paid lifetime access was revoked and replaced with free-user treatment.

exhibits.quote: Absolutely love the concept and will use it gratefully for years to come.
exhibits.argument: Buyer describes long-term continued use consistent with lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Nice LTD, using it for a couple of weeks. Amazing.
exhibits.argument: Buyer explicitly refers to the purchase as an LTD lifetime deal.

themes.summary: Several users report Google Sheets connection failures and crashing on large files.

hits.quote: I was not able to connect my Google sheets to it as Google restricted access to personal data
it not connecting to google sheets also hampered my ability to use it effectively
when I attempted to upload a large CSV file with 10,000 rows, the platform was unable to handle it and crashed

themes.summary: Many happy users say the tool is easy to use and makes beautiful charts quickly.

hits.quote: I was able to make my first simple chart soon after activating
It works very well. Has a clean interface. Easy to use
It is so simple to quickly make really good charts of all types from your data
